description: Source code for generating Code 39 barcodes, including classes for standard and extended Code 39 barcode types, with encoding and validation methods.

classes.name: Standard39
classes.description: Class for generating standard Code 39 barcodes, supporting validation and encoding of input data.

classes.name: Extended39
classes.description: Class for generating extended Code 39 barcodes, supporting additional characters through pair encoding.

methods.description: Validates the input value for the barcode, ensuring only allowed characters are present.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the validated input into barcode pattern.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Generates a decomposed pattern representation of the barcode.
